title.english: Umm Yahya bint Ya'la ibn Umayya al-Tamimiyya (2)

segments.arabic:
١٢٣٠٣- أم يحيى
بنت يعلى بن أمية التميميّة «٢» .
ذكرها القاضي أبو أحمد العسّال في «تاريخه»، فقال: أتيت النبيّ ﵌ يوم فتح مكّة، قال سعد بن الصّلت، وخالفه غيره. ذكر ذلك أبو نعيم، وقال أبو موسى: قد ذكرها ابن مندة في تاريخه، وقال: أدركت النبيّ ﵌.
segments.english:
12303—Umm Yahya bint Ya'la ibn Umayya al-Tamimiyya (2)

Al-Qadi Abu Ahmad al-Assal mentioned her in his History, saying: “I came to the Prophet—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—on the day of the conquest of Mecca.” Sa'd ibn al-Salt related it thus, but others differed from him. Abu Nu'aym mentioned that, and Abu Musa said: “Ibn Manda mentioned her in his History and said: ‘She lived to meet the Prophet—may Allah bless him and grant him peace.’”
